about: Weekly featured summon banners (gimuserver/gme/common/SummonRotation.hpp). Each game week (Monday 08:00 UTC) takes the next slot_tiles-count gates of pool, wrapping; the week starting first_week shows pool[0..]. THE POOL ORDER IS THE CALENDAR: reordering or inserting moves every future week. Append new gates at the end. A pool gate is open only in its featured weeks, even if a static tile names it. art: the tile image (content/gacha/); empty uses default_art (a "Rare Summon" tile, not the bare "Special Summon" strip).
